    • parseAndValidateZapReceipt

      public static org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<ZapReceipt> parseAndValidateZapReceipt(SignedNostrEvent zapReceiptEvent, @Nullable ZapInvoice expectedInvoice, @Nullable NostrPublicKey expectedProviderPublickey, @Nullable SignedNostrEvent expectedZapRequestEvent, @Nullable String expectedZapPreimage, @Nullable org.ngengine.lnurl.LnUrl expectedLnUrl, @Nullable NostrPublicKey expectedSender)
      This method parses and validates a zap receipt at various different levels.

      The validation takes into account all the arguments passed to this method, only the zapReceiptEvent argument is required, all the other ones are optional and are used for additional validation. This lets many different callers that have access to different levels of information about the zap request and receipt to use this same method for validation, passing the arguments they have available and leaving the others as null.

      Parameters:
      zapReceiptEvent - the zap receipt event to parse and validate. This event must be already signed and the signature is verified in this method as part of the validation process.
      expectedInvoice - if the caller has access to the original zap invoice that was paid, it can be passed in this argument for additional validation.
      expectedProviderPublickey - trusted provider key; required unless supplied by expectedInvoice.
      expectedZapRequestEvent - if the caller has access to the original zap request event, it can be passed in this argument for additional validation.
      expectedZapPreimage - if the caller has access to the expected preimage of the zap, it can be passed in this argument for additional validation.
      expectedLnUrl - if the caller has access to the expected LNURL of the zap recipient, it can be passed in this argument for additional validation.
      expectedSender - if the caller has access to the expected sender public key of the zap, it can be passed in this argument for additional validation.

    • getZapInvoices

      public static List<org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<ZapInvoice>> getZapInvoices(NostrPool pool, NostrSigner payer, @Nullable Nip01UserMetadata payerMetadata, SignedNostrEvent eventToZap, long amountInMsats, String comment) throws MalformedZapTargetException
      Get invoice to zap a Nostr event.

      The relays attached to the pool passed to this method are used to fetch recipient metadata. They are also sent to the LNURL-Pay service so it can publish the zap receipt to those relays.

      Parameters:
      pool - the NostrPool to use for fetching recipient metadata and publishing zap receipt
      payer - the signer to use for signing the zap request event
      payerMetadata - optional metadata of the payer to fill payer data fields in LNURL-Pay request
      eventToZap - the event to zap. The method will look for "zap" tags in the event to determine zap targets. If no "zap" tags are found, the method will default to zapping the event's author with a single zap of the full amount.
      amountInMsats - the amount to zap in millisatoshis
      comment - optional comment to include in the zap request
      Returns:
      a list of asynchronous tasks that will: - resolve to zap invoices, or - resolve to one or more null values if the recipient(s) do not have a payment address in their metadata, or - reject if there is an error during the process
      Throws:
      MalformedZapTargetException - if any of the zap targets in the event is malformed (e.g. missing required fields in the "zap" tag)

    • getZapInvoices

      public static List<org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<ZapInvoice>> getZapInvoices(NostrPool pool, NostrSigner payer, @Nullable Nip01UserMetadata payerMetadata, NostrPublicKey recipientPubkey, long amountInMsats, String comment)
      Get an invoice to zap a public key

      The relays attached to the pool passed to this method are used to fetch recipient metadata. They are also sent to the LNURL-Pay service so it can publish the zap receipt to those relays.

      Parameters:
      pool - the NostrPool to use for fetching recipient metadata and to request zap receipt publication
      payer - the signer of the payer of the zap
      payerMetadata - optional metadata of the payer to fill payer data fields in LNURL-Pay request
      recipientPubkey - the public key of the recipient
      amountInMsats - amount to zap in millisatoshis
      comment - comment to include in the zap request event content
      Returns:
      a list of asynchronous tasks that will: - resolve to zap invoices, or - resolve to one or more null values if the recipient does not have a payment address in their metadata, or - reject if there is an error during the process

    • getZapInvoices

      public static List<org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<ZapInvoice>> getZapInvoices(NostrSigner payer, @Nullable Nip01UserMetadata payerMetadata, org.ngengine.lnurl.LnUrl lnurlOrAddress, long amountInMsats, String comment, Set<String> relays, NostrPublicKey recipientPubkey, @Nullable NostrEvent.Coordinates eventCoordinates) throws org.ngengine.lnurl.LnUrlException
      Raw method to get a zap invoice for something.

      This method gives more control to the called but usually it is advised to use the other higher level getZapInvoices(NostrPool, NostrSigner, Nip01UserMetadata, SignedNostrEvent, long, String) or getZapInvoices(NostrPool, NostrSigner, Nip01UserMetadata, NostrPublicKey, long, String) methods instead which will handle most of the logic of determining zap targets and relays.

      The amount of the returned invoice is verified to be the same as the amount passed in the arguments

      Parameters:
      payer - The payer signer
      payerMetadata - optional payer metadata to fill payer data fields in LNURL-Pay request
      lnurlOrAddress - LNURL or Lightning Address of the recipient
      amountInMsats - amount to zap in millisatoshis
      comment - comment to include in the zap request event content
      relays - set of relays to which the zap receipt should be published
      recipientPubkey - the public key of the recipient
      eventCoordinates - optional coordinates of the event being zapped
      Returns:
      a list of asynchronous tasks that will complete with the zap invoices
      Throws:
      org.ngengine.lnurl.LnUrlException - if there is an error with the LNURL-Pay request
